novelty.new_evidence_axis: Parsed Form 4 footnote evidence that a performance award metric was achieved/certified/earned; prior Form 4 failures used transaction-code sales, exercise retention, retained ownership, or generic multi-year vesting duration and did not require an explicit achieved performance milestone.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior Form 4 compensation-context tests failed when they only used transaction-code context, exercise retention, or generic vesting duration. This tests a materially different provenance field: explicit footnote evidence that performance-award metrics were achieved, certified, satisfied, or earned.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $25M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing Form 4 usable_trade_date, missing achieved performance-award milestone footnote, same-accession sale/tax disposal, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper parses the same Form 4 performance-award achievement footnotes, same-accession disposal exclusion, price confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
